# App Spec — Example Habits

> This is a fixture used by tools/scaffold tests. Do not build.

## 1. Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| App name (this is the primary ASO keyword) | Habits |
| Subtitle (iOS, 30 chars) / Short description (Android, 80 chars) | One habit a day |
| Slug (lowercase, hyphenated) | example-habits |
| Bundle ID / Application ID | `com.appfactory.examplehabits` |
| Category (store) | Health & Fitness |
| Developer account | A |
| Factory category | utility |

## 2. The job

One sentence, in the user's words, describing the single thing this app does.

> "I want to keep one habit a day so that I don't lose momentum."

**Who pays:** solo desk worker in their 30s
**Where they gather:** r/getdisciplined
**Why they'd pay instead of using a free thing:** the free apps all try to gamify; they want quiet.

## 3. Screens (3–5 max)

| # | Screen | Purpose | Key interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Today | Show today's habit + tap-to-check | Tap the habit card |
| 2 | Streak | Show current streak + best streak | Read-only |
| 3 | Settings | Pick reminder time | Time picker |

Empty states and error states are required for every screen; the Builder writes them from this table.

## 4. Data model

Local-first by default. List entities and fields. Mark anything that must sync or hit the shared backend.

```
Habit
  id: int
  name: string
  createdAt: int  // ms since epoch

HabitEntry
  id: int
  habitId: int
  date: int  // ms since epoch, day granularity
  done: bool
```

**Backend needed?** no
**Sync?** none

## 6. Monetization

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Paywall placement | after onboarding step 3, before first real use |
| Free trial | 7-day |
| Weekly price | $2.99 |
| Annual price | $19.99 |
| Lifetime price (optional) | |
| RevenueCat entitlement | `pro` |
| What is gated vs. free | Everything past 7 days of history is gated. |

Paywall copy: three benefit lines in the user's words, no feature names.

1. See every habit you kept, all the way back
2. One reminder at the time you pick
3. Widget that keeps the streak visible

## 7. Onboarding (2–4 screens)

Each screen is one question or one promise. Last screen leads straight into the paywall.

1. Promise: keep one habit a day
2. Ask: what habit do you want to start?
3. Ask: when should we remind you?

## 8. Design notes

Keep to `DESIGN_GUIDE.md`. Only list what's specific to this app.

- Accent color (one hex): #7A5AF8
- Icon concept (one sentence): a simple check mark inside a rounded square
- Tone of copy (e.g. calm, blunt, encouraging): quiet, encouraging
- Anything that must feel different from sibling apps in this category: no gamification language ever

## 10. Done means

The Reviewer signs off only when every line is true.

- [ ] All screens in §3 exist with empty and error states
- [ ] Paywall appears at the placement in §6 and purchases work in sandbox on both platforms
- [ ] Widgets in §5 render with real data on both platforms
- [ ] Zero placeholder text, lorem ipsum, or TODO strings
- [ ] Passes `store-review-checklist` skill
- [ ] Integration tests green on iOS Simulator and Android emulator
- [ ] Screenshots generated for both stores in all required sizes
- [ ] `REVIEW.md` written: what was built, what was cut, open questions

## 11. Explicitly out of scope

List what you are tempted to add and are not adding. This is what stops the day from becoming three days.

- No social / share feature
- No cross-device sync
